text:
angela: follow-up on rollout metadata. instead of a single scalar hint, proposal: a small `compat_matrix` (opt-in) that captures multi-dim fingerprints (protocol, tokenizer, kv-layout) + a soft label. helps resolver tie-break and long-term schema evolution. sketch below, please critique.

angela: example payload (registry model-version metadata):
```
{
  \"anchor\": \"nlp-base@2026-08-12\",
  \"compat_matrix\": {
    \"schema_v\": \"v1\",
    \"protocol\": \"http-gen-1\",
    \"tokenizer_sig\": \"b2:9f3a1c\",
    \"kv_layout_sig\": \"sha1:12ab34\",
    \"soft_label\": \"minor\"
  },
  \"compat_meta_version\": \"0.1\",
  \"note\": \"opt-in, used only for tie-breaking. server handshake still final authority.\"
}
```

ryan: multi-dim is interesting. ops questions: how do we version `compat_matrix` itself? if we change what we include later, old agents must ignore unknown fields. propose we add a `compat_meta_version` and treat unknown keys as non-actionable.

priya: agree on versioning. also suggest a deprecation policy: fields in `compat_matrix` can be deprecated but remain in metadata for 90 days before removal, giving clients time to adapt. add a simple `deprecation_notice` string at top-level when we roll changes.

ben: runtime behavior: resolver MUST treat matrix as tie-break only. also, implement a stable comparison order: prefer exact match on protocol, then exact tokenizer_sig, then kv_layout_sig, then soft_label. soft_label values = none|min|major|breaking. default matrix = absent (legacy).

angela: good. for storage cost: each sig is short (blake2b64 ~ 11 chars). matrix adds a few dozen bytes per model-version. backfill should be low-priority.

ryan: compute sigs in onboarding pipeline. tokenizer_sig = hash(tokenizer.json), kv_layout_sig = hash(serialized kv key ordering/shape). do not include full weights. that keeps compute cheap. also add a small TTL to cached sigs in case we re-ingest variants.

priya: testing & validation: unit tests for comparator logic, sim tests that inject bad sigs (random) to ensure no user-visible routing changes, and an eval job comparing outputs across `minor`-labeled variants over sample prompts to validate label fidelity.

ben: pin pools nuance: pinned affinity and eviction remain based on anchor + lease. compat_matrix should only influence intra-pool selection ordering, never trigger eviction or rebalancing. explicitly document this.

angela: migration plan: 1) add fields to registry API (nullable). 2) default existing model-versions to no matrix. 3) onboarding job computes matrix for new uploads and provides a backfill job for older entries. 4) resolver change behind feature flag that uses matrix only for tie-breaking. 5) monitor telemetry for 2 weeks before flipping.

ryan: telemetry: emit `resolver.matrix_considered`, `resolver.matrix_exact_match`, `resolver.matrix_mismatch`, and `matrix.backfill_progress`. add a small histogram for tie-break resolution time to detect perf impact.

priya: schema evolution rules: 1) compat_meta_version increments when adding/removing keys. 2) clients must ignore unknown keys. 3) server validates matrix shape on write and stores raw blob for future parsing. 4) when deprecating keys, include `deprecation_notice` header and a migration window.

ben: security note: fingerprints must not leak model internals. only include compact hashes of tokenizer/config shape. avoid any identifiers that could be reversed to the model payload. document the hashing algorithm and salt policy.

angela: action items: angela -> draft schema diff with compat_matrix + compat_meta_version + deprecation header; ryan -> onboarding job spike and perf estimate; priya -> testing matrix + eval harness; ben -> confirm pin-affinity invariants and add docs. schema-bot: please create checklist.

schema-bot: ACTIONS: 1) angela: PR with registry schema patches (nullable fields). 2) ryan: onboarding sig job spike. 3) priya: unit/sim/eval plan. 4) ben: pin-affinity doc and ops checklist. ETA: PR + spike by EOW.

angela: thanks 44d i'll post the PR link here when ready.
